title: Rulecheck baseline v1
description: Counts of existing findings by rule ID and repository path, written by rulecheck baseline and read by rulecheck check --baseline. Rulecheck also requires the canonical form it writes: keys sorted, two-space indent, one trailing newline. Rules and paths without findings are omitted.

matches.description: Counts are all-match counts; a first-match count cannot be ratcheted.

matcher.description: Digest of the rule's kind, pattern, requires and selector when the counts were recorded. A rule whose digest differs cannot use these counts.

paths.description: Keyed by normalized, slash-separated repository-relative path.
